description: This file defines the Zend_Http_Client class, which implements an HTTP client supporting various HTTP methods, headers, authentication, cookies, and file uploads. It handles sending requests, redirects, and processing responses within the Zend Framework.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client
classes.description: Implements an HTTP client with capabilities for sending requests with various methods, managing headers, authentication, cookies, file uploads, redirects, and response handling within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP client with optional URI and configuration.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the next request, accepting a Zend_Uri_Http object or string.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the current request URI, as a string or object.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the HTTP client.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Defines the HTTP method for the request (GET, POST, etc.).

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers for the HTTP request.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific request header.

methods.name: setParameterGet
methods.description: Sets GET parameters.

methods.name: setParameterPost
methods.description: Sets POST parameters.

methods.name: _setParameter
methods.description: Internal method to set a parameter for GET or POST.

methods.name: getRedirectionsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of redirects followed during the last request.

methods.name: setAuth
methods.description: Configures HTTP authentication settings.

methods.name: setCookieJar
methods.description: Sets or creates a cookie jar to persist cookies across requests.

methods.name: getCookieJar
methods.description: Returns the current cookie jar object.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the request, either directly or via the cookie jar.

methods.name: setFileUpload
methods.description: Specifies a file to include in a POST request for uploading.

methods.name: setEncType
methods.description: Sets the encoding type for POST data (urlencoded or multipart).

methods.name: setRawData
methods.description: Sets raw POST data to be sent as the request body.

methods.name: setUnmaskStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables unmasking of array parameters in GET requests.

methods.name: getUnmaskStatus
methods.description: Returns whether unmasking is enabled.

methods.name: resetParameters
methods.description: Clears all request parameters, headers, and response data, for reusing the client.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Returns the last raw HTTP request sent.

methods.name: getLastResponse
methods.description: Returns the last response object received.

methods.name: setAdapter
methods.description: Sets the connection adapter used for HTTP communication.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves the connection adapter instance.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Configures streaming for response data to a file stream.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Gets the current streaming configuration status.

methods.name: _openTempStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a temporary file stream for streaming data.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request with current settings and returns a response object.

methods.name: _prepareHeaders
methods.description: Prepares and returns the set of headers for the request.

methods.name: _prepareBody
methods.description: Builds the request body based on POST parameters, files, raw data, and encoding.

methods.name: _getParametersRecursive
methods.description: Deprecated: Flattens nested parameters arrays into key-value pairs.

methods.name: _detectFileMimeType
methods.description: Attempts to detect the MIME type of a file using available PHP extensions.

methods.name: encodeFormData
methods.description: Creates a multipart/form-data part for file uploads.

methods.name: encodeAuthHeader
methods.description: Generates the Authorization header for HTTP authentication.

methods.name: _flattenParametersArray
methods.description: Recursively flattens nested parameters arrays into key-value pairs suitable for query encoding.
